name: Amber
description: Labdanum and vanilla, bergamot on top: the accord under Shalimar, Emeraude and a century of oriental perfumery.

name: Chypre
description: Coty's 1917 skeleton: bergamot, labdanum, oakmoss, patchouli.

name: Fougère
description: Houbigant's Fougère Royale, 1882: lavender, coumarin, oakmoss, bergamot. Fougères run coumarin at a few parts.

name: Cologne
description: Mostly citrus with aromatic herbs and very little base: fresh, bright and short-lived.
